title: StrataLot
description: A lot shown on a strata plan. Each strata lot is owned separately and carries a share of common expenses according to its unit entitlement.
x-validationRules: lotNumber must be unique within a strata corporation.
parcelIdentifier must be unique across all strata lots.
x-legalReviewNotes: Confirm how voting entitlement differs from unit entitlement and whether it needs its own field.

id.description: Stable identifier of this StrataLot record.

strataCorporationId.description: The strata corporation this record belongs to.

lotNumber.description: Strata lot number as shown on the strata plan.

parcelIdentifier.description: Parcel Identifier (PID) of the strata lot.

unitEntitlement.description: Unit entitlement from the Schedule of Unit Entitlement, used to apportion common expenses.

usage.description: Intended use of the strata lot.

areaSquareMetres.description: Area of the strata lot in square metres, if known.

buildingId.description: Building the strata lot is located in, if applicable.

extensions.description: Implementation-specific data, namespaced by reverse domain.
